scope: Prevent schema-3 DWG comparisons with warn-only CRC mismatches from being marked claim-eligible, without changing parser behavior.

changes.behavior: A nonzero counter blocks claim eligibility while preserving successful operation status and existing parser warn-only behavior.
changes.testCoverage: For each CRC counter, identical target and standalone warning observations produce reviewedNonPromoting, claimEligible=false, operationSucceeded=true, and both side-specific blockers; the clean baseline remains eligible.

evidenceBoundary: The CRC counters are parser diagnostics and can be warn-only for compatibility. This guard affects only evidence eligibility. It does not establish an integrity failure policy for all DWG consumers or any format-support claim.
